red-stag.name: Red Stag
baseIncluded: Personalised guided hunt
Field dressing of game in the field
Transport of trophies to a taxidermist (if required)
Digital photos and video footage of your hunt
Douglas Scoring (available upon request)
Tent or alpine hut accommodation for multi-day backpack hunts
Hired cabin or lodge accommodation for day hunts
Airport pick-up and drop-off from Christchurch (by arrangement)
